About the author

K.L. Kaye writes romantasy for readers who like their plots sharp, their spice sacred, and their emotional damage color-coded by trope. She’s a perfectionist with a soft spot for chaos, a fitness freak who stress-lifts between steamy scenes, and an introvert who would rather jump off a cliff than read her work out loud to another human. Her books are equal parts heartbreak, heat, and what the hell just happened—featuring: Girls with trauma, knives, and no time for your nonsense Boys who would destroy kingdoms just to kiss her wrist And sacred sex scenes that probably require a scented candle, a safe word, and a recovery period She writes under a pen name because she has multiple businesses, a working reputation, and exactly zero interest in describing manticore-adjacent intimacy rituals to accounting.
